title: fix(objectql)!: a runAs system flow's record writes keep the reference check while keeping their authorization elevation (#28881)
body:
Fixes #28881

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XT6ZDDQFYhmZ6kxDp4hSdwM)_

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` says a system flow's writes skip the reference check; `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` names `reference_not_found` only for the grant catalog, which this does not touch. The one docs page that states the exemption, `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 23 (and row 29c's aside), is updated in this PR.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`runAs: 'system'` 的流程写记录时（`create_record` / `update_record`，以及任何经 `resolveRunDataContext` 写数据的节点）不再跳过引用校验。写入一个已删除或不存在的 `sys_user`（或任何 lookup / master-detail 目标）时，按用户路径原样拒绝：`VALIDATION_FAILED`，字段错误 `reference_not_found`，什么都不写。
- **怎么做的**：`@objectstack/core` 新增一个内部标记（`Symbol.for`，不在任何 schema 里，作者写不出来，`ExecutionContextSchema.parse` 会丢掉它），只在 `resolveRunDataContext` 把流程提升为 system 的那一处打上。`assertReferencesResolve` 的 system 早退只对带标记的上下文不生效。走的是 `APP_AUTOMATION_ELEVATION` 的同一套先例。
- **不变的**：流程的授权提升完全不变（照样能写别人的行、绕过 RLS、限定在触发者组织内）。其他所有 system 写入者都保留豁免：种子、导入、恢复/迁移、级联与置空、启动写入、hook 与 action 自己的写。没有新错误码，没有新 key，没有新门禁，不碰 `packages/spec/**`。
- **风险与回滚**：只会拒绝"流程写了一个不存在的引用"这一种写入。先测量过：去掉豁免后，红的全是种子/单测夹具和 verify 启动探针，没有一个流程在合法地写尚不存在的引用；收窄后 dogfood 全绿。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/core/src/security/flow-write-reference-check.ts`；`packages/objectql/src/engine-referential-integrity.ts` 的早退那一行；`packages/services/service-automation/src/runtime-identity.ts` 的 system 分支。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/runas-system-reference-check.integration.test.ts`，预期 4 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位安排评审并落地。

## What changes

- **The mark** (`packages/core/src/security/flow-write-reference-check.ts`, new; exported from `@objectstack/core`). `FLOW_WRITE_REFERENCE_CHECK = Symbol.for('objectstack.core.flowWriteReferenceCheck')`, `markFlowWriteReferenceCheck(context)` and `keepsFlowWriteReferenceCheck(context)`. It follows `APP_AUTOMATION_ELEVATION`: a registry symbol survives the `{ ...context }` spreads between the node and the engine, no JSON body or flow definition can carry one, and the schema parse drops it. It lives in core because service-automation depends on core at runtime and has objectql only as a dev dependency.
- **Where it is set** (`runtime-identity.ts`). Only in the `runAs: 'system'` arm of `resolveRunDataContext`, which every CRUD node and custom node reaches through. The user arm never carries it (`crud-runas.test.ts` pins both arms with `toEqual`, which compares symbol keys).
- **Where it is read** (`engine-referential-integrity.ts`). `if (context?.isSystem) return;` becomes `if (context?.isSystem && !keepsFlowWriteReferenceCheck(context)) return;`. Everything after it is the user path's check unchanged: only caller-supplied values, probed under the existing `referenceCheckContext` (tenant kept), and the master-detail header read, which for a system caller returns every header in its organization.
- **The owner stamp.** `stampSystemInsertOwner` fills `owner_id` from the trigger user into the written fields, so it is now checked too. A system flow whose trigger user has no `sys_user` row is refused on insert. That is the case the card describes (an owner that resolves to no account), and the changeset names it.
- Docblocks on `ObjectQL#assertReferencesResolve` and `masterDetailHeaderExists` updated; `system-context.mdx` row 23 names the one system caller that keeps the check.
- `.changeset/28881-flow-write-reference-check.md`: `patch` on core, objectql and service-automation, both declaration lines, the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker and the BREAKING banner.

## Measurement first (ruling 2)

The exemption was removed by an always-false guard carrying the marker `MEASURE_NO_EXEMPT`, objectql rebuilt and the marker counted in dist, then restored and rebuilt.

| Suite with no exemption | Reds | Who |
|---|---|---|
| `@objectstack/objectql` | 5 files / 7 tests | Unit fixtures writing a dangling or forward reference under system on purpose: `engine-dangling-reference-audit`, `engine-lookup-referential-integrity`, `engine-reference-tenant-scope`, `engine-multi-reference-element-shape`, `engine-formula-hop-stored-metadata-body`. |
| `@objectstack/service-automation` | 1 file / 1 test | `runas-system-stamping`: the flow's owner stamp names trigger user `usr_member`, which the fixture never inserted as a `sys_user`. A fixture gap, fixed in this PR by seeding the row. |
| `@objectstack/runtime` | 5 files | Seed writes and stored-metadata pins: `seed-blank-reference-real-driver`, the external-object spike, two stored-metadata pins, the unresolved-object-name pin. |
| dogfood | 170 files / 41 tests | Nearly all are one cause: the verify harness's boot probe inserts `sys_invitation` naming `org_verify_audience_gate` / `usr_verify_audience_gate` (`packages/verify/src/harness.ts`) as a system write, so most files never boot. The rest are showcase system inserts in tests. |

System callers that reach the check, by grep: plugin-auth (23 files), plugin-audit, metadata-protocol (seed loader, restore), storage, sharing, security, runtime (AppPlugin seeds), objectql (cascade, set-null), approvals, settings, verify and service-automation. None of the reds is a flow writing a reference that does not exist yet, so the stop condition did not trigger. The direct check is the dogfood on the narrowed head, where every flow run keeps the check: 382 files green.

Not measured separately: the qa seeds. Seeds do not run through `resolveRunDataContext`, so they keep the exemption, and the seed control below pins that.

## Tests

`packages/services/service-automation/src/runas-system-reference-check.integration.test.ts` (new, 4 tests). The rig is real: ObjectKernel, ObjectQLPlugin, driver-sql on better-sqlite3, the real AutomationEngine and CRUD nodes, plugin-auth's identity objects and the real SecurityPlugin. `crm_task.assignee` is a lookup to `sys_user`, and `usr_deleted` is inserted and then deleted.

- `create_record` naming the deleted user: the run fails, `innerRefusal` equals `{ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', message }` where `message` is the user path's own sentence for the same write (`Assignee: no sys_user record has id "usr_deleted"`, field code `reference_not_found`), and no row exists.
- `update_record`: refused the same way, and the row keeps its assignee.
- Elevation control: the trigger user's own update of another member's row is `PERMISSION_DENIED`; the same system flow's update of it succeeds.
- Control: a seed write (`SEED_WRITE_EXECUTION_CONTEXT`) and an import's batched create (`insertMany` under `{ isSystem, skipAutomations, skipStateMachine }`, the context the import door builds) both still store `usr_not_yet_created`.

| Reading | Result |
|---|---|
| Base (production files restored to `origin/main`, tests kept, core and objectql rebuilt with `pnpm --filter`) | `Tests 2 failed, 8 passed (10)` over the new file and `runas-system-stamping`: red are create and update; both controls and stamping green. |
| Head | `Tests 10 passed (10)` |

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

From committed HEAD, `&& !keepsFlowWriteReferenceCheck(context)) return;` replaced by a guarded form (marker `ABL_M`, counted in dist), objectql rebuilt: `Tests 2 failed, 8 passed (10)`, exactly create and update. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt dist has 0 markers.

</details>

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm build` | exit 0 |
| `@objectstack/objectql` | 525 files · 10040 tests |
| `@objectstack/core` | 135 files · 2986 tests |
| `@objectstack/runtime` | 516 files · 9270 passed, 19 skipped |
| `@objectstack/service-automation` | 256 files · 3285 tests (after the pin update) |
| typecheck core, objectql, service-automation | exit 0 each |
| eslint over the touched packages' changed files | exit 0 |
| Full dogfood (narrowing arm), head `09dbbaeb` | Test Files 382 passed, 3 skipped (385) · Tests 3156 passed, 28 skipped (3184). No reds, so none to attribute to #28849 on this main. The two later commits change test pins and docs only. |
| `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (98 families) plus `check:type-check-debt` | all 98 derived families exit 0 at head `55624b17` (67 on the code diff, 31 more once the docs page joined it), plus `check:type-check-debt` exit 0; `--ran`: 98 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:system-context-census` exit 0 after the row edit. No gate added. |

</details>

## Out of scope

A multi-user (`multiple: true`) reference field keeps a deleted user's id after the user is deleted. That is not a write-time check and ruling 4 leaves it out; it is in the report with the seat as carrier.
